PRACTICAL DELIVERABLES

Actionable materials you receive

  1. 01Market Validation Dossier: Comprehensive 15-20 page report detailing market size, growth signals, and entry barriers.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Good to clarify before starting

Why conduct an assessment before outreach?

Direct outreach without market context risks burning valuable accounts with misaligned pricing or missing regional compliance requirements.

Which data sources are used?

We consult official corporate registers, trade associations, specialized B2B trade databases, and verified corporate websites.

What payment terms apply?

For fixed-scope sprints like Market Assessment, fees are invoiced upon project kick-off. Phased sprints operate with milestone-based payment structures.
